svg.title: Personal training app system architecture
svg.desc: The mobile app stores local records and drafts and synchronizes immediately on entry and every minute while visible, independently of background retry backoff, through an authenticated public HTTPS tunnel to the app API on a local computer. The owner's external AI uses its own model and calls the MCP interface through the same tunnel. App API and MCP share domain rules and a canonical database. Backend-only model requests reach a separately configured model provider for food drafts. Saved food logs, edits and deletions can be published with a nutrition-write grant. Tracker data is imported on the phone, with atomic chunked compressed history, streamed full snapshots and snapshot-keyed read-only projections computed off the UI thread. Read caches retain metadata and bounded typed recaps without changing persisted source records. New chunk manifests carry content digests; legacy manifests remain readable. Exact comma-separated food estimates persist in the backend; only cache misses call the model. Decimal aggregation returns an uncommitted review draft. Model output does not automatically save domain records. Mobile strength feedback applies deterministic fixed-load rep/hold adjustments to matching pending prescriptions through the same durable outbox. Original prescriptions and completed snapshots are retained; the backend accepts these as revisioned activity metadata rather than independently calculating progression. Each person has an account: they sign in with a username and password on the backend’s own account website, the mobile app and the tool client obtain scoped tokens through a browser sign-in rather than holding a password, and accounts and training data share one persistent PostgreSQL database; each data-access operation is scoped to the authenticated account. The account site is also where a user sets their competition, calorie goals, meals and weekly workout schedule. Schema revisions gate startup; operator migrations serialize and commit atomically. Backups are restore-verified before retention, with scheduler installation separate from code publication. Backend database work and password derivation use bounded worker capacity; model calls are also capped across accounts.

svg.desc: Training move history carries budget-recalculation provenance through the same offline outbox and canonical command API. Android and backend derive affected-day targets from accepted activity records without changing consumption or meal portions. Schema revisions gate startup; operator migrations serialize and commit atomically. Backups are restore-verified before retention, with scheduler installation separate from code publication.
